_about: ASAM multidimensional assessments (The ASAM Criteria, 3rd edition dimensions). One row per assessment: the clinician's dimensional risk rating (0 none to 4 severe) and a note per dimension. The level of care that a set of ratings fits is derived at read time by web/js/shared/asam.js, never stored here. `level_recommended` is the clinician's own recommendation.
